author: SyncRanker

sections.description:
The Modern WordPress SEO Suite & AI Content Bridge

SyncRanker delivers an enterprise-grade, modern WordPress SEO suite that is 100% free with zero account signup required for all standalone SEO features. Take total control over your search rankings with our automatic 301 redirect manager, decoupled native JSON-LD structured data engine, complete page/post/WooCommerce metadata controls, and blazing-fast XML sitemaps right inside your WordPress dashboard.

We believe essential SEO infrastructure shouldn’t be trapped behind paywalls or weigh down your server with bloated software. SyncRanker runs lean, lightning-fast, and strictly compliant with WordPress VIP and Plugin Check standards.

Bridge to Autonomous AI Content & Smart Link Sync

Ready to scale your organic traffic effortlessly? SyncRanker acts as an intelligent, high-performance bridge to the optional SyncRanker AI Cloud Studio. Seamlessly connect your site to auto-publish deeply researched, Google-safe hybrid articles that outperform standard generic AI outputs.

With autonomous topic clustering, contextual internal link synchronization, and automated SERP intent optimization, the heavy computational lifting happens in the cloud—leaving your WordPress site clean, secure, and blazing fast.

Key Features at a Glance

  • ⚡ Smart Decoupled JSON-LD Schema Engine: Native compiler executing on the save_post lifecycle to build rich structured data (Article, TechArticle, FAQPage, VideoObject, and WooCommerce Product auto-compilation) with full Elementor and page builder compatibility.
  • 🔀 Automatic 301 Redirect Manager & 404 Logger: Automatically tracks slug and permalink changes, injecting instant 301 redirects to eliminate 404 errors and preserve domain equity.
  • 🎯 Real-Time On-Page SEO Checklist & Snippet Preview: 12-point real-time content analysis with desktop/mobile SERP previews, focus keyword density tracking, and readability auditing.
  • 🏛️ Knowledge Graph & Publisher Organization Branding: Custom Organization name, logo, Knowledge Graph branding, and multi-search engine verification tags (Google, Bing, Baidu, Yandex, Pinterest).
  • 🔗 Cloud Studio & Link Sync Bridge: Dual-layer authentication (API Token & Application Passwords) and REST API integration for autonomous article publishing and bidirectional internal link discovery.

sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins -> Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for SyncRanker Connector or upload syncranker-connector.zip.
  3. Click Install Now and Activate.
  4. Go to Settings -> Permalinks and click Save Changes once to flush rewrite rules for /sync-sitemap.xml.
  5. (Optional) Go to SyncRanker in your sidebar to connect your cloud workspace for advanced AI writing features.
sections.faq:
Do I need to create an account to use the standalone SEO features?

No! SyncRanker’s core SEO features—including the 301 Redirect Manager, Decoupled JSON-LD Schema Engine, Metadata Editor, XML Sitemaps, and 12-Point On-Page Analyzer—are 100% free and run entirely locally within your WordPress site without any account creation or registration.

How does the Decoupled Native Schema Compiler work?

SyncRanker compiles rich JSON-LD schema during the WordPress save_post lifecycle and caches the result. This decoupled architecture eliminates complex runtime regex parsing during page delivery, ensuring that your rich snippets (Articles, FAQs, VideoObjects, WooCommerce Products) render in milliseconds on wp_head.

How does the Automatic Redirect Manager work?

When you modify a page, post, or WooCommerce product URL (slug), SyncRanker detects the change and automatically creates an instant 301 redirect from the old URL to the new one, preventing 404 errors and preserving your SEO rankings.

Can I migrate from my current SEO plugin?

Yes! SyncRanker includes a 1-click migration tool supporting Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO (AIOSEO), and SEOPress with zero data loss.

Is SyncRanker compatible with WooCommerce and Elementor?

Yes! SyncRanker is fully compatible with WooCommerce (automatically generating Product schema and managing product redirects) and Elementor (extracting dynamic builder data for FAQ and video schema generation).

When do I need the SyncRanker AI Cloud Studio connection?

The optional cloud connection is only needed if you want to use our autonomous AI content generation, automated article rewriting, and cloud-synchronized internal linking. Connecting to Cloud Studio offloads heavy AI computation to our servers so your website stays ultra-fast and secure.
sections.changelog:
3.4.3

  • Added Decoupled Native JSON-LD Schema Compiler on WordPress save_post lifecycle.
  • Added dynamic detection for FAQPage (headings/accordions) and VideoObject (YouTube embeds with thumbnails).
  • Added full schema compatibility for Elementor page builder content and WooCommerce products.
  • Added Organization & Knowledge Graph branding settings in admin dashboard.
  • Fixed input text rendering visibility across SEO meta box fields.
  • Fixed analyzer script hydration and null safety checks on post load.

3.4.2

  • Added Smart Dynamic JSON-LD Schema Engine (auto-generates Article, FAQ, and VideoObject schema from content).
  • Added 1-click Schema Generator inside the SEO Meta Box.
  • Improved onboarding with new Overview & Health default tab and auto-redirect upon activation.
  • Added live dynamic news feed integration from syncranker.com.
  • Enhanced internal link pool synchronization.

3.4.1

  • New: Added automated Open Graph (OG) social meta tags injection for single posts and pages.
  • New: Added Pillar / Cornerstone content selector in SEO Meta Box with REST API synchronization.
  • Enhancement: Standardized plugin name and updated metadata handling.
  • Fix: Hardened output escaping and strict sanitization across admin and REST endpoints.

3.4.0

  • Major Feature: 4-in-1 Legacy SEO Migration Engine (Seamless 1-click batch import from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and SEOPress).
  • Feature: On-Page SEO Distribution Hub & Studio Filter Endpoints for SyncRanker AI CMS (/studio/overview, /studio/posts).
  • Fix: Multi-engine Webmaster Verification meta tag rendering (Google, Bing msvalidate.01, Baidu, Yandex, Pinterest).
  • Performance: Optimized REST API routes for external Studio management and content synchronization.
  • Enhancement: Added 1:1 Redirect Manager with automated slug change tracking.
  • Compatibility: Fully tested and compatible up to WordPress 7.1.

3.3.2

  • Feature: Added built-in Redirect Manager (301, 302, 410) with automatic slug-change tracking.
  • Feature: Added visual SEO Score color indicators (Red, Orange, Green, SyncRanker Blue) to Post list columns and Top Admin Bar.
  • Fix: Resolved minor frontend/backend context switching logic for the admin bar SEO score.
  • Tweak: Extensive WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS) code sanitization and security hardening.

3.3.1

  • Enhancement: Implemented smart 3-tier “Waterfall” fallback algorithm in REST API for contextual internal link discovery.
  • Enhancement: Tier 1 matches semantic focus keywords/topics, Tier 2 fills gaps via shared category taxonomy, and Tier 3 utilizes fresh site-wide content.
  • Performance: Guaranteed strict post deduplication and current post ID exclusion across all internal linking queries.
  • Optimization: Added intelligent edge-case detection (isNewSite flag & post count threshold) to support clean AI content publishing on new WordPress sites.
  • Tested: Fully validated for WordPress REST API high-concurrency standards and SEO link architecture.

3.3.0

  • Major Release: Upgraded to 12-point real-time On-Page SEO scoring engine.
  • Added native Stylized XML Sitemap index engine (/sync-sitemap.xml) with XSL stylesheet support.
  • Added intelligent entity and morphological keyword matching in first 100 words.
  • Added Table of Contents detection and AI transitional filler scrubber.
  • Added featured image alt-text verification in SEO checklist.
  • Added on-demand REST endpoints for topic uniqueness and contextual internal link discovery.
  • 100% WordPress VIP and Plugin Check (PCP) security and performance compliance.

3.2.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org.
